observed_facts: The pattern is for the end of a transaction and conveys that the transaction was completed.
It calls for a reference number when one exists, next steps and timing, contact details, and a savable transaction record.
Its example confirms submission while explaining that registration confirmation or further questions happen later.
The page explicitly identifies a research gap for transactions that are part of wider user tasks.
limits: The example demonstrates transaction-scope wording; it does not validate a specific booking-reschedule or cancellation flow.
The pattern alone does not establish backend completion or prove UX effectiveness in this fixture.
